title: Étale pullback commutes with forgetting constant-ring module coefficients

from.place: proof, applying the algebraically closed hypothesis to the pulled-back module sheaf

statement: For a commutative ring Λ, a morphism p : X -> Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and a sheaf F of Λ-modules on Y's small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the underlying abelian sheaf of the module pullback p^*F is isomorphic to the abelian pullback p^* of the underlying abelian sheaf of F [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. No torsion, properness, field, or cohomology hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Unfold the small étale upper-star construction: left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf followed by sheafification. The forgetful functor ModuleCat Λ -> AddCommGrpCat preserves colimits and limits. Use Mathlib Functor.lanCompIsoOfPreserves to commute it with the Kan extension, and sheafComposeNatIso to commute it with sheafification. Their composite gives the asserted isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem pullback_forget_modules_iso (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Nonempty ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).obj F) ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj
        ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F))
